title: The Fremennik Isles
start: Talk to Mord Gunnars in northern Rellekka.

items.t: Ores (can be noted) depending on your Mining level:

recommended.t: Prayer potions, food, and combat-boosting potions
The catspeak amulet for extra dialogue during the quest

kills.t: 10 Ice trolls (consisting of level 53 ice troll runts, level 68 ice troll females, level 68 ice troll grunts and level 68 ice troll males)

rewards.t: 2 x 10000 Combat XP in Strength, Attack, Defence, or Constitution
14000 coins in assorted rewards during the quest.
A replaceable Fremennik royal helmet known as the Helm of Neitiznot, which is an upgrade to the warrior helm with a +3 prayer bonus and a better defensive bonus.
Access to a new tree, the arctic pine.
Access to a new mine north-east of Neitiznot that contains drakolith rocks.
Access to a new mine near Jatizso with mithril rocks and coal rocks, and a new mine with banite rocks (require completion of the elite Fremennik achievements).
The ability to make yak hide armour which protects against the granite clubs wielded by the trolls and the shield which protects against the stones thrown by the trolls.
The Contraband Yak Produce store is available on Jatizso if the player refunds the 5000 coins tax to Vanligga Gastfrihet, north of the king.
Ned in Draynor Village will now give an additional rope for free each time rope is purchased from him.

steps.t: Right click and talk to Mord Gunnars on the northern Rellekka dock about Jatizso's history. [Chat: Accept › 1 Tell me more about Jatizso's history. › 3 Can you ferry me to Jatizso?]
In Jatizso, talk to King Gjuki Sorvott IV in the building with tiled floors.
Give the King a raw tuna or use the tuna on the cat.

sub.t: Can be obtained from the cage/harpoon fishing spots to the south.

steps.t: Give the King your ores.

sub.t: There is a mine down the stairs to the north-west if you didn't bring them.

steps.t: Open the chest (behind the throne) and take the silly jester outfit. [Chat: 1 Take the silly jester hat. › 1 Take the silly jester top. › 1 Take the silly jester tights.]
Return to Rellekka and Travel-Neitiznot Maria Gunnars.
Equip the silly jester outfit, with nothing in your hands, and talk to Slug Hemligssen, north of the bank. [Chat: 4 Free stuff please. › 1 I am ready.]
Talk to Mawnis Burowgar in the building south of the bank. Dismiss any Summoning familiars and pets.
Use the jester controls to follow Mawnis's instructions.
Return to Slug Hemligssen. [Chat: 1 Yes I have. › 3 They will be ready in two days. › 2 Seventeen militia have been trained. › 1 There are two bridges to repair.]
Remove the silly jester outfit (keep it for later) and talk to Mawnis Burowgar.
If you don't have 8 ropes:

sub.t: Kill yaks for 8 yak hair and spin them on the spinning wheel in the southeastern-most house.
Optionally, make an additional rope for later in the quest.
Take three yak-hide for later if you don't already have them.

steps.t: If you don't have 8 split logs:

sub.t: Cross the bridge to the north.
Chop 8 arctic pine logs if you don't already have them.
Optionally, chop 2 more for later in the quest. Don't split these 2, keep them whole.
Use logs on the woodcutting stump across the bridge to the north (not a regular tree stump).

steps.t: Talk to Mawnis Burowgar with the items.
Talk to Thakkrad Sigmundson about the bridges. [Chat: 1 How do I repair these bridges again? › 2 Where do I find these bridges?]
Right click bridges, north of Neitiznot, to repair them.
Talk to Mawnis Burowgar.
Return to King Gjuki Sorvott IV on Jatizso.
Tax the shop keepers of Jatizso:

sub.t: Hring Hring must pay 8,000; he is in southwesternmost house. [Chat: 1 But rules are rules. Pay up!]
Skuli Myrka must pay 6,000, north of Hring. [Chat: 1 But, rules are rules. Pay up!]
Vanligga Gastfrihet must pay 5,000, north of the king's palace. [Chat: 2 I suppose I could pay the tax for you.]
Keepa Kettilon must pay 5,000, east from Vanligga. [Chat: 1 But rules are rules. Pay up!]

steps.t: Return to King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
Tax all bearded people for 1k:

sub.t: Hring Hring. [Chat: 1 But rules are rules. Pay up!]
Raum Urda-Stein in a house with Hring Hring. [Chat: 1 But rules are rules. Pay up!]
Skuli Myrka, north of Raum and Hring. [Chat: 1 But rules are rules. Pay up!]
Keepa Kettilon, he is in the northeasternmost house. [Chat: 1 But rules are rules. Pay up!]
Flosi Dalksson in a house with Keepa Kettilon. [Chat: 1 But rules are rules. Pay up!]

steps.t: Return to King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
Return to Rellekka, and take the boat to Neitiznot.
Equip the silly jester outfit and talk to Slug Hemligssen.
Empty your hands and entertain Mawnis Burowgar again.
Talk to Slug Hemligssen. [Chat: 1 Yes, I am. › 2 They are in a secluded bay, near Etceteria. › 1 They will be given some potions. › 3 I have been helping Neitiznot.]
Talk to King Gjuki Sorvott IV in Jatizso.

sub.t: Make sure King Gjuki Sorvott IV gives you the Royal decree first. You may need to speak with him twice.

steps.t: Remove the silly jester outfit and talk to Mawnis Burowgar in Neitiznot.
To obtain a yak-hide armour set:

sub.t: Kill three yaks and give the three yak hides to Thakkrad Sigmundson to tan. [Chat: 1 Cure all my hides.]
Craft the top and legs with thread in the backpack.
Thread can be bought from Jofridr Mordstatter in the building with the bank chests north of Mawnis Burowgar.

steps.t: Talk to Mawnis Burowgar when you have the yak armour.

sub.t: Make sure Mawnis mentions "Fremennik round shield" in order to craft the shield. You may need to speak with him twice.

steps.t: To obtain a round shield:

sub.t: Buy 1 bronze nail from Jofridr in the bank, obtain 1 rope, chop two arctic logs
Take everything to a woodcutting stump and interact with the woodcutting stump to craft the Fremennik round shield.

steps.t: Talk to Mawnis Burowgar with these items.
Prepare for battle then enter the Ice Troll Caves to the far east of the northern-most island.

sub.t: Protect from Ranged is advised. Familiars are not allowed. Equipping the Fremennik round shield drastically reduces Range damage taken from Ice Troll Females. Yak-hide armour drastically reduces Melee damage taken from Ice Troll Males, Runts, and Grunts. If you do not have good Ranged Defence, bring high-healing food. Even with Protect From Ranged active, the trolls quickly deplete your health. The Ice Troll King has a very high defence to ranged, so it is not advised to kill the boss with ranged weapons.

Talk to or right click Request-supplies on Bork Sigmundson for seven Tunas, four 4 dose Strength potions, and two 3 dose Prayer potions if you need supplies. [Chat: 1 Give me food, Bork! › 2 I need Strength potions! › 3 I need Prayer potions!]

p: The Honour Guard fight the trolls!
A player fights the Ice Troll King.

steps.t: Kill 10 ice trolls (killing the trolls by farcasting the ones on the east does not count).

sub.t: There is a chatbox message saying "You have defeated enough trolls to attack the King."

steps.t: Cross the bridge, kill and then decapitate the Ice Troll King.
Take the head to Mawnis Burowgar.
Quest complete!
